email.subject: Founding Engineer at Glimmer Health
email.body:
Hi,

I'm the co-founder of Glimmer Health, an early-stage startup building tools for clinics. We've just raised our seed round, and I'm looking for a Founding Engineer to build the product with me.

I read your blog post on building small, reliable backends, and I think you'd enjoy the problems we're working on. Would you be open to hearing more?

Noah Kim
Co-founder, Glimmer Health
